# `pygeovision label`

Create training labels automatically: `osm` burns OpenStreetMap features into a raster; `quality` checks a label raster
for obvious problems. See [Labeling](../../labeling/index.md).

## When to use it

Use `label osm` when you have imagery and need quick, approximate training labels. Use `label quality` before training on any label set.

## What you get

`osm` writes a class raster (and a GeoJSON of the features): buildings 1, roads 2, water 3 and so on.
`quality` prints checks (class balance, slivers, coverage, connectivity) and can save an HTML report.

## Things to know

* Give `--reference` (the image) so the labels sit on the image's exact grid and CRS.
* The box is four positional numbers, so a negative longitude is read as an option. Put the options first and `--` before the
  numbers: `label osm -o labels/osm.tif -- -74.05 40.70 -73.95 40.80`.
* OpenStreetMap is incomplete in many regions and out of date elsewhere; labels are approximate, not truth
  ([OSM labeling](../../labeling/osm.md)).
* `label quality` uses raster-only heuristics. It is **not** a measure of accuracy.

## Commands

```text
Usage: pygeovision label [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Auto-labeling from OSM, satellite data, and foundation models.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  osm      Generate labels from OpenStreetMap (class values: buildings 1, roads 2, water 3,...
  quality  Assess label quality (raster-only heuristics; not a measure of accuracy).
```

### `pygeovision label osm`

Generate labels from OpenStreetMap (class values: buildings 1, roads 2, water 3, vegetation 4, agricultural 5, commercial 6, residential 7, solar_panels 8, parking 9, sports 10).

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `LON_MIN LAT_MIN LON_MAX LAT_MAX` | number | yes |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--output`, `-o` | text | `./labels/osm.tif` |  | Label raster to write. |
| `--categories`, `-c` | text | `['buildings', 'roads', 'water']` |  | Repeat for several: buildings roads water vegetation agricultural commercial residential solar_panels parking sports. |
| `--reference` | path |  |  | Imagery raster: write the labels on its exact grid and CRS (recommended for training). |
| `--resolution` | number | `10.0` |  | Pixel size in metres when there is no --reference. |
| `--all-touched` | flag | off |  | Burn every pixel an area touches (keeps tiny buildings). |
| `--vector`, `--no-vector` | flag | `--vector` |  | Also write the features as GeoJSON. |

:::{dropdown} Full help text

```text
Usage: pygeovision label osm [OPTIONS] LON_MIN LAT_MIN LON_MAX LAT_MAX

  Generate labels from OpenStreetMap (class values: buildings 1, roads 2, water 3, vegetation 4,
  agricultural 5, commercial 6, residential 7, solar_panels 8, parking 9, sports 10).

Options:
  -o, --output TEXT       Label raster to write.  [default: ./labels/osm.tif]
  -c, --categories TEXT   Repeat for several: buildings roads water vegetation agricultural
                          commercial residential solar_panels parking sports.  [default:
                          buildings, roads, water]
  --reference PATH        Imagery raster: write the labels on its exact grid and CRS
                          (recommended for training).
  --resolution FLOAT      Pixel size in metres when there is no --reference.  [default: 10.0]
  --all-touched           Burn every pixel an area touches (keeps tiny buildings).
  --vector / --no-vector  Also write the features as GeoJSON.  [default: vector]
  --help                  Show this message and exit.
```
:::

### `pygeovision label quality`

Assess label quality (raster-only heuristics; not a measure of accuracy).

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `LABEL_PATH` | text | yes |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--num-classes` | integer |  |  | Classes are 0..N-1. Default: inferred from the raster. |
| `--check` | one of `class_balance` | `slivers` | `coverage` | `connectivity` | `boundaries` |  |  | Run only these checks (repeatable). Default: all except boundaries. |
| `--html` | flag | off |  | Save HTML report |

:::{dropdown} Full help text

```text
Usage: pygeovision label quality [OPTIONS] LABEL_PATH

  Assess label quality (raster-only heuristics; not a measure of accuracy).

Options:
  --num-classes INTEGER           Classes are 0..N-1. Default: inferred from the raster.
  --check [class_balance|slivers|coverage|connectivity|boundaries]
                                  Run only these checks (repeatable). Default: all except
                                  boundaries.
  --html                          Save HTML report
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
```
:::
